text: You've chosen your KPIs. Now: where do they actually go on the page?

Most people read top to bottom, left to right — so the headline fact goes top-left, with detail increasing as the eye moves further. A card visual is the simplest way to make one number impossible to miss. Size alone signals importance, before anyone's processed what it means.

Here's that principle applied for real. Total Volume, top-left — the single highest-level number on the page. Moving right and down: a trend, a segment breakdown, progressively more specific detail. Nothing here is accidental.

And it all has to fit on one screen, no scrollbars — consistent scales and colors throughout, so nobody has to relearn a convention tile by tile. Next: storytelling with data — choosing visuals that actually support the point you're making.
